dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing of the visible 2D mass from the mid-point toward the posterior terminal point, with more pronounced curvature on the right margin.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Significant asymmetrical bulge on the mid-left lateral margin; minor irregular protrusion on the anterior right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white baseline with high pixel intensity across the majority of the dorsal field.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency with a single longitudinal dark-pixel formation along the central posterior axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between the dark posterior linear feature and the depigmented dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single longitudinal high-contrast dark mark on the posterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct linear dark pigmented mark on the lower dorsal axis.
other_distinctive_markers: Marked bilateral asymmetry caused by a localized widening of the left mid-body margin.
